propositions: A child closed with disposition class (duplicate/not_a_bug/escalated) and a live replacement link produces no completion-verifier attestation by design (exemption granted in transition_close.py), but child_closure_findings requires one anyway, withholding the parent's certification with no non-dishonest remedy.

The close path correctly exempts dispositions from billable verification at transition_close.py:253-260, but the certification path at llm/completion.py:170-199 does not recognize this exemption, creating an unresolvable state where a correctly-closed duplicate is forever uncertified.

A disposition close should mint a completion-verifier attestation with manifest reading 'DISPOSITION <class>' plus replacement id, allowing child_closure_findings to resolve certification through the replacement link rather than requiring an attestation the child is exempt from producing.

The fix must preserve that no completion PASS is claimed in signed bytes (maintaining auditability of verified vs. disposition closures) and ensure --force-close remains unsigned regardless of disposition class.
